hits.title: Realtime Robotics names Kevin Carlin Chief Executive Officer to lead company's next phase of growth.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-08-13] Realtime Robotics, Inc. hired Kevin Carlin as Chief Executive Officer on Aug 13th '26. Realtime Robotics, the leader in industrial AI for automated robot system design and deployment, today announced that Kevin Carlin has been appointed Chief Executive Officer, effective immediately.
